# collapsible

Native DisclosureGroup, distinct from accordion.

![collapsible preview](../images/items/collapsible-light.png)

More previews: [dark](../images/items/collapsible-dark.png)

Nothing to install. Copy the snippet below

## Usage

```swift
@State private var isShowingDetails = false

DisclosureGroup("Fee breakdown", isExpanded: $isShowingDetails) {
    LabeledContent("Transfer fee", value: "KWD 1.000")
    LabeledContent("Exchange margin", value: "KWD 0.450")
}
```

## Why native is enough

`DisclosureGroup`: 1 region. `accordion`: several stacked. No extra treatment.

## Details

- Kind: recipe
- Version: 0.1.0
- Platforms: iOS 26.0+
- Accessibility contract:
  - Disclosure announces expanded/collapsed.
  - Keep label meaningful: collapsed, VoiceOver reads only it.
